svg.title: 9 skills, one line each — why having nine costs almost nothing
svg.desc: An animated diagram of the kit's 9 Bob skills. The six main-chain skills and the three situational ones appear in turn as cards, each showing its one-line description and what its body would cost. A readout counts up to roughly 596 tokens: that is the entire standing cost of the descriptions. A stacked bar then shows what you actually pay in the context window — Bob's own baseline of about 9,230 tokens plus that sliver — and a second bar shows the counterfactual: if all 9 skill bodies were always loaded it would cost about 8,604 tokens instead, roughly 14 times as much, every single turn, spent on instructions you are not using.
svg.text: Only the description sits in context. The body loads on demand.
